## 2) Inputs

```{r inputs}
n_runs <- 10L
seed_start <- 2026L

root_nb <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/server_json_runs"
root_nm <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/server_json_runs_nm"

run_sources <- tibble::tribble(
  ~run_option, ~alg_dir, ~json_name,
  "Server_InnerProduct", "innerproduct", "innerproduct.json",
  "Server_SnapATAC", "snapatac", "snapatac.json",
  "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF", "snapatac", "snapatac.json"
)

run_option_levels <- c("Server_InnerProduct", "Server_SnapATAC", "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF")

model_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~model_role, ~method,
  "raw", "raw",
  "gb", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)",
```

## 3) Resolve JSON Paths

```{r path_resolve}
resolve_json_path <- function(roots_chr, dset_name, alg_dir, json_name) {
  roots <- strsplit(roots_chr, "\\|", fixed = FALSE)[[1]]
  roots <- roots[nzchar(roots)]

  for (rt in roots) {
    candidates <- c(
      file.path(rt, dset_name, "1M", alg_dir, json_name),
      file.path(rt, alg_dir, dset_name, sprintf("%s_1M_%s", dset_name, json_name)),
      file.path(rt, alg_dir, dset_name, json_name)
    )
    hit <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[[1]])
  }
  NA_character_
}

path_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  run_option = run_sources$run_option,
  model_role = model_map$model_role,
  run = seq_len(n_runs)
) %>%
  left_join(run_sources, by = "run_option") %>%
  left_join(model_map, by = "model_role") %>%
  mutate(
    seed = seed_start + run - 1L,
    dset_name = case_when(
      # InnerProduct panel
      run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" & model_role == "raw" ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_raw_pairs_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" & model_role == "gb"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" & model_role == "nm"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_r%02d", run),

      # SnapATAC (IDF) panel
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" & model_role == "raw" ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_raw_pairs_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" & model_role == "gb"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" & model_role == "nm"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_r%02d", run),

      # SnapATAC noIDF panel
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" & model_role == "raw" ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_raw_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" & model_role == "gb"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_gb_only_r%02d", run),
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" & model_role == "nm"  ~ sprintf("oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r%02d", run),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    roots_chr = case_when(
      run_option %in% c("Server_InnerProduct", "Server_SnapATAC") & model_role %in% c("raw", "gb") ~ root_nb,
      run_option %in% c("Server_InnerProduct", "Server_SnapATAC") & model_role == "nm" ~ root_nm,
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" & model_role == "gb" ~ paste(root_nb, root_nm, sep = "|"),
      run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" ~ root_nm,
      TRUE ~ root_nm
    ),
    json_path = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(roots_chr, dset_name, alg_dir, json_name),
      resolve_json_path
    ),
    exists = !is.na(json_path)
  )

missing_tbl <- path_tbl %>% filter(!exists)
if (nrow(missing_tbl) > 0) {
  warning("Missing JSON files for some run_option/model/run rows. They will be skipped.")
  print(missing_tbl %>% select(run_option, model_role, run, seed, dset_name, roots_chr))
}

coverage_tbl <- path_tbl %>%
  group_by(run_option, model_role) %>%
  summarise(found = sum(exists), total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * found / total)) %>%
  arrange(run_option, model_role)
print(coverage_tbl)
```

## 4) Extract ARI/NMI/Silhouette Families + AvgBIO from JSON

```{r extract}
first_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(x)) x <- unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(vals) == 0 || all(is.na(vals))) return(NA_real_)
  vals[which(!is.na(vals))[1]]
}

extract_relevant_metrics <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble(metric = character(), value = numeric()))
  }

  j <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  keys <- names(j)
  if (is.null(keys) || length(keys) == 0) {
    return(tibble(metric = character(), value = numeric()))
  }

  vals <- purrr::map_dbl(keys, ~ first_numeric(j[[.x]]))
  base_df <- tibble(metric = keys, value = vals) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    filter(grepl("(ari|nmi|silhouette)", metric, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!grepl("silhouette-gt", metric, ignore.case = TRUE))

  best_ari <- first_numeric(j[["best_ari"]])
  best_nmi <- first_numeric(j[["best_nmi"]])
  best_asw <- first_numeric(j[["best_silhouette"]])
  avgBio <- mean(c(best_ari, best_nmi, best_asw), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (all(is.na(c(best_ari, best_nmi, best_asw)))) avgBio <- NA_real_

  bind_rows(base_df, tibble(metric = "avgBio", value = avgBio))
}

metric_order <- c(
  "ari_agglomerative", "ari_gmm", "ari_k-means", "ari_leiden", "ari_louvain", "best_ari",
  "nmi_agglomerative", "nmi_gmm", "nmi_k-means", "nmi_leiden", "nmi_louvain", "best_nmi",
  "silhouette_agglomerative", "silhouette_gmm", "silhouette_k-means",
  "silhouette_leiden", "silhouette_louvain", "best_silhouette",
  "avgBio"
)

plot_df <- path_tbl %>%
  filter(exists) %>%
  mutate(metrics = purrr::map(json_path, extract_relevant_metrics)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(metrics) %>%
  filter(metric %in% metric_order) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_order),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("raw", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)")),
    run_option = factor(run_option, levels = run_option_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(run_option, method, run, metric)
```

## 6) Plot (Facet Rows by Panel)

```{r plot, fig.width=15, fig.height=12}
group_boundaries <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = levels(plot_df$metric),
  idx = seq_along(levels(plot_df$metric)),
  metric_group = case_when(
    grepl("^ari|best_ari$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ARI",
    grepl("^nmi|best_nmi$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NMI",
    grepl("silhouette", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Silhouette",
    metric == "avgBio" ~ "AvgBIO",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
)

separator_x <- group_boundaries %>%
  group_by(metric_group) %>%
  summarise(last_idx = max(idx), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(last_idx)

if (nrow(separator_x) > 1) {
  separator_x <- separator_x$last_idx[seq_len(nrow(separator_x) - 1)] + 0.5
} else {
  separator_x <- numeric(0)
}

label_x <- group_boundaries %>%
  group_by(metric_group) %>%
  summarise(x = mean(idx), .groups = "drop")

facet_y <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(run_option) %>%
  summarise(y_group_label = 1, .groups = "drop")

label_df <- tidyr::crossing(facet_y, label_x)

panel_labeller <- c(
  "Server_InnerProduct" = "InnerProduct",
  "Server_SnapATAC" = "SnapATAC",
  "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" = "SnapATAC (no IDF)"
)

p_rows <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = metric, y = value, fill = method, color = method)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.68,
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.78, jitter.width = 0.10)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = separator_x,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y_group_label, label = metric_group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(run_option ~ ., scales = "fixed", labeller = as_labeller(panel_labeller)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("raw" = "#4E79A7", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)" = "#E15759", "HiCBZIP-N(M)" = "#59A14F"),
    labels = c("raw" = "Raw", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)" = "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)" = "HiCBZIP-N(M)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("raw" = "#2F5D8A", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)" = "#B63D40", "HiCBZIP-N(M)" = "#3E7C38"),
    labels = c("raw" = "Raw", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)" = "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)" = "HiCBZIP-N(M)")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Three Panels × Three Models: Clustering Metrics Comparison",
    subtitle = "Panels: InnerProduct / SnapATAC / SnapATAC(no IDF); Models: Raw / HiCBZIP-NB(GS) / HiCBZIP-N(M)",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Model",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_rows)
```

## 8) Run-1 PCA 3x3 (Rows=Embedding Panel, Cols=Imputation Model)

```{r pca_3x3_run1, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
read_h5ad_obs_col <- function(obs_group, key) {
  node <- obs_group[[key]]
  if (inherits(node, "H5Group")) {
    nms <- names(node)
    if (all(c("codes", "categories") %in% nms)) {
      codes <- as.integer(node[["codes"]]$read())
      categories <- as.character(node[["categories"]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[codes + 1L]))
    }
  }
  if (inherits(node, "H5D")) {
    vals <- node$read()
    attrs <- tryCatch(hdf5r::h5attr_names(node), error = function(e) character(0))
    if ("categories" %in% attrs) {
      cats_obj <- hdf5r::h5attr(node, "categories")
      categories <- as.character(cats_obj$dereference()[[1]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[as.integer(vals) + 1L]))
    }
    return(as.vector(as.character(vals)))
  }
  stop("Unsupported obs encoding for key: ", key)
}

read_h5ad_pca2d <- function(path) {
  h5 <- hdf5r::H5File$new(path, mode = "r")
  on.exit(try(h5$close_all(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  if (!("obsm" %in% names(h5)) || !("X_pca" %in% names(h5[["obsm"]]))) {
    stop("Missing obsm/X_pca in: ", path)
  }
  x_pca <- as.matrix(h5[["obsm"]][["X_pca"]]$read())
  if (ncol(x_pca) < 2) stop("X_pca has fewer than 2 columns in: ", path)

  celltype <- factor(as.vector(read_h5ad_obs_col(h5[["obs"]], "celltype")))
  if (nrow(x_pca) != length(celltype) && ncol(x_pca) == length(celltype)) {
    x_pca <- t(x_pca)
  }
  if (nrow(x_pca) != length(celltype)) {
    stop("X_pca shape mismatch with celltype labels in: ", path)
  }

  tibble(PC1 = x_pca[, 1], PC2 = x_pca[, 2], celltype = celltype)
}

resolve_first_existing <- function(paths) {
  hit <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(hit) > 0) hit[[1]] else NA_character_
}

vis_map <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  run_option = run_option_levels,
  method = c("raw", "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    run = 1L,
    h5ad = pmap_chr(
      list(run_option, method),
      function(run_option, method) {
        candidates <- character(0)

        if (run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" && method == "raw") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_raw_pairs_r01", "1M", "innerproduct", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" && method == "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_r01", "1M", "innerproduct", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_InnerProduct" && method == "HiCBZIP-N(M)") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_r01", "1M", "innerproduct", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }

        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" && method == "raw") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_raw_pairs_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" && method == "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC" && method == "HiCBZIP-N(M)") {
          candidates <- c(file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"))
        }

        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" && method == "raw") {
          candidates <- c(
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_raw_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_raw_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r01_viz", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad")
          )
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" && method == "HiCBZIP-NB(GS)") {
          candidates <- c(
            file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_gb_only_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_gb_only_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
            file.path(root_nb, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_gb_only_r01_viz", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_gb_only_r01_viz", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad")
          )
        }
        if (run_option == "Server_SnapATAC_noIDF" && method == "HiCBZIP-N(M)") {
          candidates <- c(
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r01", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
            file.path(root_nm, "oocyte_zygote_bhzip_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r01_viz", "1M", "snapatac", "anndata_obj.h5ad")
          )
        }

        resolve_first_existing(candidates)
      }
    ),
    exists = !is.na(h5ad)
  )

if (!all(vis_map$exists)) {
```
